note: The verbal derivation of the gentilic is uncertain.
summary: Genesis lists the Hivites among the clans descended from Canaan. The same word identifies Hamor as a member of that people.

senses.definition: A member of the Hivite people. The singular also designates the people collectively.

evidence.note: The Hivites appear alongside the Arkites and Sinites in the genealogy of Canaan.
Hamor, the father of Shechem, is called הַחִוִּי.
